models.note: KEYLESS — no answer model, no judge, no provider call, no API key, no cost. The MMR-diversity probe supplies EXPLICIT 4-dim embedding vectors at store time and the candidates are FTS-ranked (no model query embedding needed), so the diversity claim is exercised whenever sqlite-vec is available (vecAvailable). The intent classifier + temporal-range grammar are LLM-free deterministic code.

recallIq.note: MMR/intent/range exercised ONLY by the new keyless recall-iq-contribution.bench.test.ts this plan added. The shipped qa/retrieval/contradiction harnesses construct createMemoryRecall WITHOUT mmr/queryUnderstanding/embeddingStore (verified retrieval-harness.bench.test.ts:225-247) — the SAME KG-05 / REASON-05 structural gap — so they exercise the IQ features NOT AT ALL. See GATE-REPORT.md §3. vectorLane is the model-driven text->embedding boolean (false: no LLAMA_MODEL_PATH); the deterministic diversity claim does not depend on it (it supplies its own vectors).

measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.name: QA cross-judge accuracy lift on temporal / IE-precision / abstention from the IQ knobs
measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.why: The shipped qa/retrieval/contradiction harnesses do NOT wire the new recall knobs (no mmr, no queryUnderstanding, no embeddingStore — verified retrieval-harness.bench.test.ts:225-247), the SAME KG-05 / REASON-05 structural gap. Making a costed QA cross-judge measure an IQ-ON lift requires FIRST (a) wiring the QA recall path with mmr/queryUnderstanding/embeddingStore AND (b) a costed cross-judge re-run (answer model + >=2 judges) over the J1 corpus — there is no keyless judge. That harness extension is beyond this regression-gate plan's scope. Therefore the costed QA cross-judge temporal/IE/abstention lift is an OPERATOR COSTED RE-RUN, scheduled after the QA harness is extended (a Phase-102 gap-closure or a follow-on plan). NO accuracy delta is quoted — quoting a guessed delta would be exactly the fabrication this gate exists to prevent.

honestyProtocol: Every number in GATE-REPORT.md traces to a committed JSON in this directory (read back from disk + asserted in the harness before quoting). The bench is keyless — no QA accuracy number is produced or quoted; the QA cross-judge cell is explicitly 'not measured — operator costed re-run', NOT a guessed delta. A post-run credential-shape sweep over the manifest is clean: no secret-key prefixes, bearer-token markers, or credential field names — the manifest carries pure numbers + booleans.
